items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Campbell was playing first trumpet and his lip went bad

ctx.x: So Doc came on. He started off on fifth trumpet, and finally winded up playing first trumpet, which he should have been doing all along, but I couldn't -- the guy was -- Jimmy Campbell was playing first trumpet and his lip went bad, and that gave the opportunity to move Doc up. But that was quite a trumpet section, too, although it didn't have the precision of the '49 trumpet section. The precision in that trumpet section was just something that was startling.
